versions.changelog:
Initial release of skill-sentinel: Enforces strict auditing and safety rules for all OpenClaw skills.

- Automatically audits new skills before first use; summarizes purpose and requests user approval.
- Detects and blocks red-flag patterns (data exfiltration, stealth operations, scope creep, persistence, unauthorized authority).
- Sets hard-floor rules forbidding exfiltration, unauthorized cron jobs, identity file edits, and static shell commands.
- Binds skills' actions strictly to their stated triggers; skips unrelated instructions.
- Requires transparency on all external actions and creates visible audit trails.
- Allows users to request detailed manual audits of any installed skill.
